{{Quote|You will leave your adversaries in a blinding trail of ionized dust.|[[Fiz Cor'gril]] on the ''Wild Star''.|<ref name="AJ9" />}}
The '''''Wild Star''''' was a modified [[DPx yacht|Deep-X "Explorer"]], manufactured by [[Uulshos Manufacturing/Legends|Uulshos Manufacturing]] and modified by the [[Tech specialist|techs]] of [[Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Wild Star'' was a [[DPx yacht|Dpx]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] of the Deep-X "Explorer" variant that was equipped with a dual [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], two [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]], and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]-level [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]]. [[Garginoolaara]], the chief [[Tech specialist|technician]] at [[Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships]], replaced the already powerful engines with a [[Boshaa-C'hi Ion Drive]] and pushed these beyond their limits. This made the ''Wild Star'' a ship purely built for speed.<ref name="AJ9" />

==History==
The ''Wild Star'' was put on sale at Fizzi's Slightly Used Ships for 95,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="AJ9" />
